title: trichoballia involucrata
intro: Trichoballia involucrata, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and Mexico, known for its bright yellow and orange flowers. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Desert Marigold include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
